description: This file implements middleware functions for authentication in a Node.js/Express application. It includes functions to extract Bearer tokens from request headers, derive user identity from tokens, load user data from a MongoDB database, and attach user context to requests. It also provides middleware to enforce authentication requirements.

methods.name: getBearerToken
methods.description: Extracts the Bearer token from the Authorization header of the request.

methods.name: deriveIdentityFromToken
methods.description: Derives a user identity object from a simple token pattern, supporting demo, user, and email formats.

methods.name: loadUserFromDb
methods.description: Loads a user document from the database based on provided identity info and headers.

methods.name: attachAuthContext
methods.description: Middleware factory that attaches a user object to the request if a valid Bearer token is present.

methods.name: requireAuth
methods.description: Middleware that enforces the presence of an authenticated user on the request.
